title: Landing on a Mountbatten property seen by his gardener

tellings.quote: I think there's a story that something landed on one of his properties. >> Wow. >> And his gardener saw it.

plain: Something is said to have landed on one of the estates of the British aristocrat Louis Mountbatten, and his gardener supposedly saw it. A researcher named Jason Simosa mentions this to Michels in passing and hedges it, saying 'I think there's a story', with no source given.
